semantic_boundary: Commit-event semantic disposition only; no claim that documentation statements independently prove runtime behavior or that cumulative file snapshots were exhaustively re-read.

commits.title: Move founder story from README to ABOUT.md
commits.material_delta: Relocated project-origin biography from README to ABOUT. Nontechnical provenance only; sensitive biographical material must not be propagated into FRANK/user state by assimilation.

commits.title: Switch all LLM-facing text to English, add desktop screenshot
commits.material_delta: Renamed the prompt workspace surface toward INNER_WORLD, explicitly required internal-state values to shape tone/behavior silently rather than be reported, shortened default style, and removed self-defense priming from the default profile. Historical precursor for current distinction between internal state, perceptual backing and user-visible claims.

commits.title: Add Model Memory Pressure Control to router
commits.material_delta: Added mutually exclusive heavy-model residency: park/mask Llama, start Qwen, health-check, rollback to Llama on failure, idle swap-back, lock-order discipline and health observability. Reusable resource-state-machine and rollback oracle for Needle/model routing; masking a service is historical mechanism, not current authority design.

commits.title: Add How Frank works in 5 minutes guide
commits.material_delta: Added concise architecture guide summarizing model swap, memory, personality, safety and vision. Useful as historical narrative cross-check only; statements inherit evidence from runtime/source and cannot establish mechanisms independently.

commits.title: Overhaul idle thinking: diverse English prompts, fix deep reflection gates
commits.material_delta: Replaced single repetitive idle prompt with rotating category pool, increased budget, relaxed mouse/RAM reflection gates and added anti-repetition control after observed repetitive output. Historical lesson: background cognition quality and liveness are jointly controlled by trigger diversity plus resource/idle gates; thresholds require measured liveness/safety rather than intuition.

commits.title: Add language enforcement for 7B models
commits.material_delta: System prompt alone did not stop 7B language mirroring, so language state and a near-generation reply nudge were duplicated across direct core and overlay paths. This is evidence that weak small-model control instructions can require a stronger boundary/control plane, but duplicating control state across paths creates drift risk.

commits.title: Add GRF paper and rewrite ABOUT.md with paper-to-system mapping
commits.material_delta: Documented a conceptual mapping from GRF principles to E-PQ/GWT/Ego/event ordering/information/self-model/safety and added the GRF paper artifact. Preserve as design-intent/theory lineage, not as proof that those runtime mechanisms satisfy the philosophical/scientific claims; each causal/mechanistic assertion still needs executable evidence.

commits.title: Fix language tag visibility: use lang metadata prefix
commits.material_delta: The 7B model referenced the visible control phrase '[Reply in English]' in its own responses. Control was moved to a less conversational metadata prefix and a rebuild-variable bug was fixed. Direct precursor to current typed Needle/Clay boundary law: control metadata must be structurally separated from semantic user/model content and tested for leakage.

block_findings: Internal state was already being separated from user-visible reporting: hidden state should modulate behavior without becoming automatic factual output.
Heavy-model resource arbitration had an explicit reversible state machine with health checks and rollback, providing historical mechanism/test value for current routing.
Background thought liveness suffered from repetitive prompting and overly restrictive gates, showing that daemon existence is not sufficient for useful autonomous cognition.
Small 7B language-control instructions leaked into generated text when encoded as conversational content; typed/out-of-band control is superior to natural-language prompt tags.
Theory-to-system documentation is valuable lineage but must be epistemically separated from executable evidence.

current_inheritance.delta: Represent control directives such as language/routing/resource policy as typed metadata/effects outside semantic user content; add leakage tests.
Regressionize prompt-control echo, duplicated language-state drift across entry paths, model-swap failure/rollback, and background-gate starvation/repetition.
Preserve distinction among hidden internal state, user-visible claim, documentation assertion and executable evidence class.
Resource residency transitions need explicit states, health confirmation, failure rollback and deterministic lock/authority ordering.

earned_work.reason: Strong reusable mechanisms/failure oracles but overlap existing routing/state/background-learning/control-boundary mappings; defer global dedup.
